hero.title: Share Raja Bali With Friends
hero.body: Word of mouth means the world to us. Tap a platform below to share Raja Bali, a short message is already written for you.

shareButtons.shareMessage: I just had an amazing evening at Raja Bali in Nusa Dua! Authentic Balinese food, live cultural performances, and wonderful hospitality. Highly recommend it if you're in Bali!
shareButtons.igNote: Message copied — open Instagram and paste it into a DM, Story, or your bio.
